method: Assistant visual inspection of actual installed-Edge screenshots using the image viewer. Automated interaction results are in documentation-browser.json.
findings: Main title, navigation, failed qualification and limits are readable at1440 and390 pixels.
The calibrated terminal-range plot keeps four separately labelled cells and units. Detailed calibration rows use a horizontally scrollable table.
Blind measured motion, forecast range and numerical coverage are readable, with no false physical-world coverage claim.
Narrow module details wrap the descriptive text and long source path without page overflow.
Twenty real app captures load; automated checks exercise all five policies,60 disturbed cases and12 unsupported cases without fabricated motion.
limitations: The page is a long, offline evidence explorer; individual screenshots show only the currently scrolled section.
Wide numerical tables retain their own horizontal scrolling on narrow displays.
